about_the_game:
Build a deck from a vast selection of towers, traps, and spells, then strategically place your defenses as waves of enemies attack. Your deck is your arsenal, summon towers to hold the line, set deadly traps, and cast powerful spells to turn the tide of battle.

Between battles, uncover powerful artifacts that change how you play. Draft new cards, forge synergies, and grow stronger with each run.

With each run offering fresh choices, randomized upgrades, and evolving challenges, no two games are the same. Will you forge an unstoppable defense, or will The Doom claim your world next?

Artifacts, spells, and card upgrades all combine to create game-changing interactions. Strengthen towers with elemental buffs, unleash chain reactions with spells, or empower traps to trigger massive devastation. The right combination can turn the tide of battle!

No two runs are the same! Different enemy combinations, randomized card rewards, and a wide variety of artifacts, upgrades, hero powers and shops ensure that each play through offers a fresh challenge. Experiment with different decks and strategies to uncover the most powerful builds.

In between each level, you will have the chance to visit various merchants and locations in order to improve your deck. Will you visit the trader to look for better cards, seek support from the nobility or gamble your gold in the den for a chance at powerful upgrades?

Choose from a variety of great houses, each with a unique play style and starting deck. Will you embrace raw elemental power, cunning trap strategies, or relentless tower synergy? Adapt your deck with each run to discover devastating new combos.

Expand your arsenal by unlocking new great houses, each with unique decks and play styles. Whether you prefer overwhelming enemies with relentless towers, setting intricate trap chains, or harnessing the raw power of elemental magic, every house offers a fresh way to experience the game. Experiment, adapt, and find the perfect strategy to hold the gate!

As you grow in power, so does you enemies. You unlock harder difficulties in order to get even more powerful upgrades!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA* GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD* Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7500
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2070 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
